db:select.doc:name: Select Monitored Emails
db:select.db:sql: SELECT e.id, e.gmail_message_id, e.gmail_thread_id, e.sender_email, e.sender_domain, e.sender_name, e.subject, e.snippet, to_char(e.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS received_at, e.is_unread, CAST(e.label_ids AS text) AS label_ids, c.category, c.urgency_level, c.requires_action, c.possible_action, c.classification_reason, c.classifier_version FROM emails e LEFT JOIN email_classifications c ON c.email_id = e.id AND c.classifier_version = 'heuristic-v1' WHERE (CAST(:emailId AS text) IS NULL OR CAST(e.id AS text) = CAST(:emailId AS text)) AND (CAST(:category AS text) IS NULL OR c.category = CAST(:category AS text)) AND (CAST(:urgencyLevel AS text) IS NULL OR c.urgency_level = CAST(:urgencyLevel AS text)) AND (CAST(:sender AS text) IS NULL OR e.sender_email = CAST(:sender AS text)) AND (CAST(:fromDate AS date) IS NULL OR CAST(e.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Fortaleza' AS date) >= CAST(:fromDate AS date)) AND (CAST(:toDate AS date) IS NULL OR CAST(e.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Fortaleza' AS date) <= CAST(:toDate AS date)) AND (CAST(:cursor AS timestamptz) IS NULL OR e.received_at < CAST(:cursor AS timestamptz)) AND (CAST(:unreadOnly AS boolean) = false OR e.is_unread = true) ORDER BY e.received_at DESC LIMIT CAST(:limit AS integer)
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ emailId: vars.emailFilters.emailId, category: vars.emailFilters.category, urgencyLevel: vars.emailFilters.urgencyLevel, sender: vars.emailFilters.sender, fromDate: vars.emailFilters.fromDate, toDate: vars.emailFilters.toDate, cursor: vars.emailFilters.cursor, unreadOnly: vars.emailFilters.unreadOnly default false, limit: vars.emailFilters.limit default 20 }]
